jobs.description:
ABOUT CLIPBOARD

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company https://www.ycombinator.com/topcompanies/ and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

The Strategy & Ops Senior Associate role is an experienced generalist role at Clipboard suited for the “all-around athlete” type who can do it all and wants exposure to a range of problems and opportunities.

You’re likely someone who’s interested in and capable of solving different problem types – you’re resourceful, adaptable, and confident you can figure it out if you can sink your teeth in deep enough.

Your first “tour of duty” will be on the Billing team (see more below). The specific projects you take on will depend on your strengths and what we learn during the recruiting process and your first days at Clipboard; that being said, here is a list of example initiatives to give you an idea:

- Build an internal predictive analytics model and corresponding underwriting process to catch bad payers early with high accuracy to inform our contracting decisions and risk mitigation tactics

- Research, vet, and onboard a new vendor that embeds AI agents into our customer-facing collections efforts

- Redesign our process for converting workplaces to new methods of payment, such as getting customers who send checks to start paying us via eCheck to speed up the cash conversion process

- Manage a team of Billing Account Managers

FIRST TOUR OF DUTY – QUICK BACKGROUND ON BILLING

Our most immediate need right now is on the Billing team. The TLDR is that we want to maximize our profitability by collecting money as fast as possible and minimizing losses, while preserving the customer experience, all in service of reliably converting revenue into cash (the lifeline of a capital-intensive business like ours). This in a way is “ensuring high-quality growth” for the company.

Although Clipboard provides a service where workplaces can find qualified professionals to fill shifts, we are in many ways a lending company at our core since we pay professionals immediately after they work a shift. For illustrative purposes: a nurse works a shift → we pay the nurse $100 immediately with our cash → the workplace pays us $120 a month later. We extend debt to workplaces using cash we borrow, with interest, from an Asset-Backed Line (ABL) of credit – workplaces use that debt to pay their staffing costs, and we expect to be paid back by the workplaces at a later date based on agreed-upon net terms.

Billing is doing the critical work of converting our revenue into cash that we put in the bank. Otherwise, money we cannot collect is money we’ve already burned. With thousands of customers operating in different regulatory environments, under different conditions, with nuanced capital structures and corporate setups, and using varied complicated processes…this can be hard to do at scale. We consistently fight a multi-faceted battle: a battle wherein we must maximize the speed at which we recognize revenue, maximize the margin associated with each shift, and maximize the customer experience, all without letting one unduly impact the other.

Optimizing collections is critical to make sure Clipboard is generating sustainable, high-quality growth and turning top-line revenue into cash that we use to service or grow other parts of the business, and you will help us do that.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We find those who are most successful in this type of role:

- Are insatiably curious and notice non-obvious clues and patterns: Curiosity https://creatingvalue.substack.com/i/46535664/noticing-and-curiosity sits atop our company values. Understanding something from first principles and getting to the root cause of the problem will often reveal the best solution, and a natural and unwavering curiosity to keep asking questions and digging will take you most of the way.

- Roll up their sleeves and go to the source: There are multiple ways to say this: touching reality, dogfooding, seeing for yourself, going to the front-lines, etc. Don’t just take someone’s word for it – go find out yourself by testing the feature, or listening to the agent call, or calling the customer, or executing the workflow. This is how you seek truth.

- Bring a tenacity and persistence to problem-solving: You’ll hit walls and find yourself in uncertain and unfamiliar situations. If you can sit with the uncertainty, look at the problem from new angles, and keep applying pressure to a problem – you’ll position yourself for breakthroughs.

- Bounce back from failure quickly: You’ll make mistakes, move in the wrong direction, and stumble from time-to-time. Just avoid big mistakes and don’t make the same mistakes twice, and learn from them quickly. Worry less about failing and more about losing momentum in your feedback loop. If you fail cheaply and quickly, that's worth the lesson/learning you get in return.

While performance on your case and interviews during the hiring process is the most important aspect of your candidacy, your years of relevant working experience will be taken into consideration for both (a) the work you’re placed into once hired and (b) compensation.

WHY JOIN CLIPBOARD?

- 100% Remote – Always. Work from anywhere in the world.

- Fast-Paced Startup Environment. Join a company that values curiosity, independence, and growth.

- A Hiring Process That Rewards Skills, Not Just Experience. Every applicant gets a fair shot—our selection is based on real-world problem-solving ability, not just credentials.

- Opportunity to make a significant impact with our workplace customers.

HIRING PROCESS

1. Application

2. Case Study 1

3. Interview 1

4. Case Study 2 [OPTIONAL]

5. Interview 2 [OPTIONAL]

6. Interview with Head of Operations

7. Interview with Head of People

SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS

To succeed in this role, you must have:

- A reliable laptop/desktop (no Chromebooks or Linux OS).

- Minimum 20 Mbps wired internet connection.

- Wired headset for clear communication.

- A quiet, distraction-free workspace.

- Stable power and internet connectivity

*After submitting your application, please check your spam folder periodically over the next few days for updates.

#LI-DNI

Quick Note on Scammers:

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here https://forms.gle/SyGaxHFbon7Hg9fW6.

We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

OVERVIEW

📍 Remote - South Africa

Want to sit at the intersection of Support, Engineering, and Product? Clipboard is hiring Technical Support Engineers (TSEs) to act as the primary escalation layer for technical issues across our platform. You'll own the investigation, reproduction, and - where applicable- agent-assisted fix implementation that turns noisy customer reports into validated, high-signal work, so Engineering only receives production-ready problems for final review.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for people who love digging into hard problems with real diagnostic tools, who care about getting to the root cause rather than just clearing a queue, and who want their investigations to directly protect platform reliability for hundreds of thousands of healthcare workers and the facilities that depend on them.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Monitor escalation channels and the Technical Support queue in Zendesk, catching early signals of systemic problems before they reach customers

- Investigate complex product, platform, and data-layer issues using tools like Datadog, internal dashboards, and SQL, reproducing bugs and producing evidence-backed escalations to Engineering.

- Handle live incidents end-to-end, from detection to closure: React to an incident with urgency, coordinate across Support, Engineering, and Product, and keep stakeholders updated with clear, structured communication

- Implement fixes where appropriate, testing your changes before handing off to Engineering for final review and sign-off

- Perform Root Cause Analysis and post-incident reviews, translating each issue into learnings that reduce recurrence and improve monitoring

- Maintain operational workflows (geofence, facility quizzes, NFC) accurately and quickly while spotting trends for prevention

- Capture investigative learnings in clear troubleshooting guides and documentation, and submit structured proposals that turn recurring patterns into actionable improvements

- Uphold our values such as unreasonably fast, ownership, and uncomfortably high standards in every interaction

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Technical Fluency - You're comfortable investigating issues with observability tools (e.g., Datadog), writing SQL to interrogate data, and reasoning about APIs, backend configurations, and feature toggles. You can tell the difference between a UI, data, and code-level problem.

- Diagnostic Rigor - Every investigation you produce is thorough, evidence-based, and reproducible. You rule out config and data causes before escalating, and your write-ups are clear enough for another engineer to pick up without rework.

- End-to-End Ownership - You own problems from first report to confirmed resolution, including stakeholder updates and follow-through, with no gaps between hand-offs.

- Composure Under Pressure - You stay structured and calm during live incidents, balancing speed with accuracy and communicating clearly when stakes are high.

- Adaptability & Prioritization - You juggle structured work (incidents, bugs, workflows) with unplanned high-priority requests without letting SLAs slip.

- Systems & Prevention Thinking - You treat every issue as a chance to learn, identifying gaps in monitoring, tooling, or process and proposing fixes that prevent recurrence.

- Fluent, professional-level English communication, both written and verbal.

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with observability and analytics tooling (Datadog, Sentry, Snowflake, or similar)

- Familiarity with SQL and reading application logs

- Background in technical support, SRE, incident response, or a related engineering-adjacent function

- Exposure to AI-assisted coding/agent tooling

- Experience in Ops, Support, or CX environments at scale

HIRING PROCESS

- Application Review

- Skills Assessment via Case Study

- Case Interview with Tech Support Team Lead

- Interview with Head of Worker Experience

This is a very critical role to ensure that the cash flows for the company are smooth. The BR will reach out to the workplaces through phone and email to follow up on payments, get a commitment of payment ("promise to pay"), and ensure that the workplaces honor these commitments. - Build relationships with workplaces (e.g., properly set expectations about our billing policy, explain NET & Dispute Terms, etc.).

- Identify the root cause of non-payment and resolve billing concerns.

- Report on collections updates and accounts receivable status.

- Identify critical accounts and devise SMART action plans to address issues.

- High attention to detail.

- Receptive to feedback (highly coachable).

You’ll play a key role in ensuring professionals can get to work quickly while meeting compliance standards across facilities and regulatory requirements.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Monitor and manage queues for document submissions, backlogs, and expirations during assigned shifts, acting on real-time prioritization

- Own and execute daily tasks including document status updates, document mapping, resolving unread submissions, and supporting special projects

- Contribute to ongoing improvements by reviewing internal policies and recommending updates that enhance clarity and efficiency

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve document-related inquiries and improve internal workflows

- Communicate clearly via Slack and other internal tools to ensure alignment and resolution of issues

- Stay informed on evolving documentation standards and product updates to ensure consistent, accurate decision-making

- Meet targets for document review time, accuracy, and throughput, contributing to both individual and team performance goals

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Detail Orientation – You have a sharp eye for detail and can identify inconsistencies or missing information quickly and accurately.

Decision Making – You’re confident making timely decisions, even in ambiguous situations, while maintaining high standards for accuracy and compliance.

Organization & Execution – You manage multiple tasks and queues effectively, maintaining consistency and reliability in a fast-paced environment.

Communication – You communicate clearly and concisely, especially when explaining decisions or collaborating across teams.

Ownership Mindset – You take responsibility for your work, follow through on tasks, and contribute to improving processes over time.

NICE TO HAVE

- Prior experience in document verification, credentialing, compliance operations, administrative support, or customer service

- Familiarity with U.S. healthcare documentation (e.g., licenses, certifications, immunization records)

- Experience with QA or quality-focused roles

- Familiarity with tools like Slack, Zendesk, Google Sheets, and task management platforms

HIRING PROCESS

- Application

- Assessment (sent via email within 1–2 days; please check your spam folder)

- Interview with a member of our recruiting team

- Final interviews and offer

TECHNICAL & WORKSPACE REQUIREMENTS

Candidates are expected to have:

- Residence within the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region.

- A wired internet connection with a minimum download speed of 15 Mbps.

- A computer meeting the following minimum specifications:

- Intel Core i5 (8th Generation or newer)

- Solve ambiguous problems. Work through requests from sales reps, managers, and leadership, figure out what is actually needed, and execute quickly.

- Direct AI agents. Write specs and prompts, supervise AI agents, and rigorously QA their output before it touches production data.

- Build automations and tools. Create scripts, scheduled jobs, Slack bots, and lightweight web apps that turn recurring manual work into scalable systems.

- Analyze and report. Use SQL and other tools to answer important revenue questions and build reporting the organization can trust.

- Guard data quality. Handle merges, deduplication, account mapping, enrichment, and other work required to keep our systems accurate at scale.

- Evidence of building. You've built scripts, automations, tools, systems, or other solutions to real problems.

- AI-native working style. You already use AI to multiply your output and understand where it can fail and how to verify its work.

- High judgment under ambiguity. You can take a loosely defined problem, figure out what matters, and know when to act versus when to ask.

- Strong attention to detail. You're comfortable being the last line of defense before changes affect production systems and large datasets.

- Bias to ownership. When something you own breaks, you don't just fix the immediate issue. You look for the underlying problem and improve the system.

- Analyze operational data to spot trends and bottlenecks, and turn your findings into clear recommendations that guide business decisions.

- Research and evaluate new tools, including AI, automation, and internal systems, and drive their adoption to make operations more effective.

- Design processes, workflows, and operating procedures that improve efficiency, quality, and customer experience

- Lead cross-functional projects and strategic initiatives from planning through execution, partnering with Operations, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and other teams.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 2–6 years of experience in a problem-solving role, such as strategy or management consulting, operations, strategy & operations, implementation, customer strategy, or program management.

- Experience solving operational problems by improving processes, designing workflows, or building scalable systems, while juggling multiple priorities in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

- Strong analytical skills, with comfort using data (e.g., SQL, Python) to diagnose problems and support decisions.

- Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex problems simply and align stakeholders across teams, from frontline operators to senior leaders.

- A high level of ownership. You don’t stop at the recommendation; you stay with the problem until it’s solved.

- A habit of going to the source: testing the feature, listening to the agent call, calling the customer, or running the workflow.

You set the standard the team applies, and you are the named decision-maker when a case is hard. What the law requires is a given. How we meet it is up to you, and you own that call.

This is not a people management role. The work is recurring by design. The same categories of questions arrive every week, alongside state license renewals and reporting that run on a fixed calendar and never finish. Your value is in reaching the same well-reasoned decision every time and documenting your reasoning well enough that others can apply it. You'll work closely with Agents, SMEs, Team Leads, and Legal, none of whom report to you, so your credibility comes from the quality and consistency of your judgment rather than from authority.

You will report to the Head of the Documents Team.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

Judgment and decisions

- Serve as the named escalation point for background check disqualification decisions

- Make the initial call on agency compliance implementation

- Handle escalations on worker credential verification, including license violations and reprimands

- Decide which questions you resolve and document yourself, and which warrant partnering with Legal

Written analysis

- Produce risk analyses in a consistent format: the question, your research, your reasoning, your recommended path.

- Evaluate new state and agency requirements before implementation, quantifying what compliance costs a worker in time, money, and completion rate, and recommending how we implement.

- Build and maintain the decision record that lets other people reach the same conclusion you would

Recurring compliance operations

- Own the credential verification audits

- Plan and drive the implementation of high-value requirements, such as continuing education

- State license renewals

- Ongoing state reporting

REQUIREMENTS:

- Bachelor’s degree.

- At least 5 years of professional experience.

- Prior experience in a role where you applied regulations to real decisions. Examples:

- regulatory or compliance-focused paralegal

- regulatory compliance specialist

- legal analyst

- background screening adjudicator

- trust and safety or eligibility policy at a marketplace

- Experience interpreting statutes, regulations, or agency guidance and turning them into operational requirements.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

- You can reach a defensible decision when documentation is incomplete or unavailable, and you're explicit about what your reasoning rests on.

- You can read complex regulatory material and work out how it applies in practice to a marketplace model.

- You weigh compliance risk against business impact and find the path that meets the requirement without restricting more than it demands.

- You write decision memos and business cases that leadership can act on.

- You build credibility with people who don't report to you.

- You own recurring work with hard deadlines, such as license renewals and state reporting.

- Willingness to maintain overlapping working hours with Eastern and Pacific time (ET/PT).

NICE TO HAVE:

- Compliance, regulatory, or licensing experience in healthcare, staffing, or another regulated industry.

- Experience at a government or regulatory agency.

- Experience with independent contractor or marketplace models.

- Experience with background check adjudication or adverse action processes.

- Experience with state licensing filings.

SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS

- Minimum 15Mbps wired internet connection

- Minimum i5 processor or equivalent

- Minimum 12GB RAM

- Dedicated, quiet working environment

- Reliable power source and backup internet connection

Want to sit at the intersection of Support, Engineering, and Product? Clipboard is hiring Technical Support Engineers (TSEs) to act as the primary escalation layer for technical issues across our platform. You'll own the investigation, reproduction, and - where applicable- agent-assisted fix implementation that turns noisy customer reports into validated, high-signal work, so Engineering only receives production-ready problems for final review.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for people who love digging into hard problems with real diagnostic tools, who care about getting to the root cause rather than just clearing a queue, and who want their investigations to directly protect platform reliability for hundreds of thousands of healthcare workers and the facilities that depend on them.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Monitor escalation channels and the Technical Support queue in Zendesk, catching early signals of systemic problems before they reach customers

- Investigate complex product, platform, and data-layer issues using tools like Datadog, internal dashboards, and SQL, reproducing bugs and producing evidence-backed escalations to Engineering.

- Handle live incidents end-to-end, from detection to closure: React to an incident with urgency, coordinate across Support, Engineering, and Product, and keep stakeholders updated with clear, structured communication

- Implement fixes where appropriate, testing your changes before handing off to Engineering for final review and sign-off

- Perform Root Cause Analysis and post-incident reviews, translating each issue into learnings that reduce recurrence and improve monitoring

- Maintain operational workflows (geofence, facility quizzes, NFC) accurately and quickly while spotting trends for prevention

- Capture investigative learnings in clear troubleshooting guides and documentation, and submit structured proposals that turn recurring patterns into actionable improvements

- Uphold our values such as unreasonably fast, ownership, and uncomfortably high standards in every interaction

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Technical Fluency - You're comfortable investigating issues with observability tools (e.g., Datadog), writing SQL to interrogate data, and reasoning about APIs, backend configurations, and feature toggles. You can tell the difference between a UI, data, and code-level problem.

- Diagnostic Rigor - Every investigation you produce is thorough, evidence-based, and reproducible. You rule out config and data causes before escalating, and your write-ups are clear enough for another engineer to pick up without rework.

- End-to-End Ownership - You own problems from first report to confirmed resolution, including stakeholder updates and follow-through, with no gaps between hand-offs.

- Composure Under Pressure - You stay structured and calm during live incidents, balancing speed with accuracy and communicating clearly when stakes are high.

- Adaptability & Prioritization - You juggle structured work (incidents, bugs, workflows) with unplanned high-priority requests without letting SLAs slip.

- Systems & Prevention Thinking - You treat every issue as a chance to learn, identifying gaps in monitoring, tooling, or process and proposing fixes that prevent recurrence.

- Fluent, professional-level English communication, both written and verbal.

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with observability and analytics tooling (Datadog, Sentry, Snowflake, or similar)

- Familiarity with SQL and reading application logs

- Background in technical support, SRE, incident response, or a related engineering-adjacent function

- Exposure to AI-assisted coding/agent tooling

- Experience in Ops, Support, or CX environments at scale

HIRING PROCESS

- Application Review

- Skills Assessment via Case Study

- Case Interview with Tech Support Team Lead

- Interview with Head of Worker Experience
